lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular clusters is visible posterior to the gills, featuring a transition from high-density, small-diameter spots near the head to larger, more widely spaced blobs along the mid-lateral line.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect horizontal rows of blobs, creating a grid-like configuration most prominent in the central lateral flank region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge is visible along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient transition from high-intensity (light) on the dorsal side to low-intensity (shadow) on the ventral side.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The macro-mask of the first dorsal fin contains approximately 10-15 distinct high-luminance blobs distributed unevenly, with a higher concentration of clusters located near the anterior base.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple commensal Echeneidae organisms (remoras) attached or swimming in close proximity to the ventral and lateral surfaces.
